citations.section_or_article: Rule FLUTTER-FONTS-01: Static Google Fonts Bundling (Munich Privacy Ruling)
citations.text:
### Rule FLUTTER-FONTS-01: Static Google Fonts Bundling (Munich Privacy Ruling)
- **Requirement**: Flutter apps using `google_fonts` must NOT fetch TTF/WOFF files dynamically over HTTP at runtime from Google servers.
- **Rule ID**: `SEC-PRIV-GOOGLE-FONTS`
- **Remediation**:
  1. Set `GoogleFonts.config.allowRuntimeFetching = false;` in `main()` before `runApp()`.
  2. Declare local TTF font assets inside `pubspec.yaml`.
citations.legal_risk: Non-compliance with Rule FLUTTER-FONTS-01: Static Google Fonts Bundling (Munich Privacy Ruling)

citations.text:
### A04:2021 - Insecure Design (CWE-209, CWE-256, CWE-501)
- **Violation Patterns**: Missing business logic controls, unverified age checks, non-consensual session telemetry (`SEC-PRIV-COPPA-AGEGATE`, `SEC-PRIV-SESSION-REPLAY`).
- **Remediation Standard**:
  - Threat modeling integrated into CI/CD.
  - Strict input validation schemas (Pydantic, Zod) on all ingress boundaries.
citations.legal_risk: Non-compliance with A04:2021 - Insecure Design (CWE-209, CWE-256, CWE-501)

patch.proposed_code:
GoogleFonts.config.allowRuntimeFetching = false;
// Bundle font assets in pubspec.yaml
patch.patch_diff:
--- a/index.html
+++ b/index.html
@@ -1 +1,2 @@
-<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">+GoogleFonts.config.allowRuntimeFetching = false;
+// Bundle font assets in pubspec.yaml
patch.explanation: Auto-generated compliant replacement conforming to PRIV-07.
